mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to its 5-year median compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (historical median), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary policy and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust economic output, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth weakens (PAYEMS decline from prior month) and the federal funds rate is elevated (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the market anticipates reduced corporate hiring and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (relative to 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
